_comment: M-BEAUTY Task B1 (2026-07-05): ship-neutral-first -- every map carries IDENTITY grade values ([1,1,1], vignette 0) so atmosphere.gd is live end-to-end with ZERO visible change this task; later rollout tasks (R1/R2) tuned inn/street/floodplains/cave_mouth for real -- see the entries below and CLAUDE.md's rollout blocks. `meta.phase_thresholds` is LIVE as of the M-BEAUTY final-review fix wave (2026-07-05, Fix 3): game.gd's `_build_sim` now reads this dict and passes {dusk_at, night_at} into WIGame's `phase_config` ctor arg (previously it passed none, so WIGame._phase_config silently fell back to its own hardcoded 40/90 defaults -- see wi_game.gd's phase() doc comment). Track P1 (2026-07-06 playtest directive 'dark before you reach Liscor'): dusk/night RETUNED 40/90 -> 100/225 so the honest inn->Liscor onboarding route (measured N~60 post-Warrior-sleep actions to arrive at street; gate_district_walkthrough hits actions_since_sleep==62 at map_changed{street}) now lands in LATE DAY with dusk ~38 actions later (dusk_at 100 ~=1.6xN; night_at 225 = 2.25x dusk_at). These no longer equal wi_game.gd's hardcoded 40/90 fallback -- game.gd's injection is what makes THESE the live values; changing dusk/night here genuinely moves phase_changed in every event stream, same full-canonical-seed-reverify rule as combat data (CLAUDE.md's Equipment/M-BEAUTY block). atmosphere_check.json's dusk-crossing route is SIZED to dusk_at and was re-sized 40->100 moves in lockstep with this change. `meta.light_energy_by_phase` is read by atmosphere.gd's `light_multiplier` (day 0.0 keeps every light invisible by day, preserving today's look; live since Task B2).

Phosphor/shaft lights glow only at dusk/night (light_energy_by_phase day=0.0); the always-on pond_glints/dust ambience carries the day-phase atmosphere against this grade.
